project_summary: Predictive maintenance platform for wind turbines with SCADA data lake and ML scoring

components.name: SCADA data ingestion (Azure Functions)
components.description: Streaming ingestion from turbine PLCs to Azure Data Lake with partitioning by site and turbine ID.

components.name: Failure prediction ML pipeline
components.description: Feature engineering on vibration/temperature signals, model training in Azure ML, and batch scoring jobs.

components.name: Maintenance work order integration
components.description: Automatic CMMS work order creation when risk score exceeds threshold with technician mobile notifications.

components.name: Fleet operations visualization
components.description: Power BI embedded reports and 3D turbine health map for operations center.

components.name: Edge gateway firmware interface
components.description: Protocol adapter for Modbus TCP at substation edge with offline store-and-forward.
